name: start_build_capture
description: Begin REA's capture of the app on a build computer started from a request, inside the computer: REA downloads the package lists as the computer's user so the capture finds the app's sources, launches the app from its desktop entry under capture (do not open it from the menu first) and returns once its window is open, with a screenshot. Then make the seed through the app and save it, mark_build_checkpoint seed, make the change the task asks for and save it, mark_build_checkpoint end, and stop_build_capture.
